title: REQ · Boy and NPC characters are data-driven and animate idle, walk and interact from the manifest
summary: Scene content declares characters whose animations resolve from manifest spritesheets
description: Context: bedroom.yaml has no characters; manifest has character:boy (idle), character:boy-walk, character:boy-interact; BootScene only loads image assets. Desired: a validated scene characters list, a pure animation resolver with idle fallback, preloading of spritesheets and Phaser sprites playing idle and interact on object click. Expected: boy shown idling, interact animation on click. Why: living scene, NPCs addable by content only.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character spec with idle, walk and interact entries, when resolved against the manifest, then each returns that sheet's animation name
Given a state with no matching entry or unknown asset, when resolved, then the idle animation is returned
Given scene yaml with a characters list, when parsed by sceneSchema, then valid characters pass and a missing animations.idle fails with a path-named error
Given an objectClick event, when BootScene handles it, then the boy plays interact then returns to idle
technical_constraints: planPreload stays pure with no Phaser import
definition_of_done: Boy defined in bedroom.yaml and animates
